aboutGame.title: What is Ecos La Brea?
paragraphs: Ecos La Brea is a prehistoric survival game on Roblox where you play as an ancient Ice Age creature. Spawn into a living ecosystem inspired by the real La Brea Tar Pits, choose a predator like the Smilodon or Dire Wolf, or a herbivore like the Woolly Mammoth, and fight to survive in a world where every animal is another player.

Master scent-based tracking, creature calls, and territory control as you carve out your place in the food chain. Our wiki breaks down every playable species, biome, hunting tactic, and hidden location so you can thrive from the grasslands to the tar pits.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Ecos La Brea.

items.question: What is Ecos La Brea?
items.answer: Ecos La Brea is a prehistoric survival game on Roblox where you play as an ancient Ice Age creature in an ecosystem inspired by the real La Brea Tar Pits. Hunt, track, and fight other players as predators like the Smilodon or herbivores like the Woolly Mammoth.

items.question: Which creature should beginners play in Ecos La Brea?
items.answer: Start with a fast, forgiving creature while you learn the map and controls, then move to bigger predators once you can track prey and manage stamina in a fight.

items.question: Is Ecos La Brea free to play?
items.answer: Yes. Ecos La Brea is free to play on Roblox, and no purchase is needed to pick a creature and start surviving.

items.question: How do I find creatures and other players in Ecos La Brea?
items.answer: Use scent tracking, footprints, and creature calls to locate both prey and rivals, then check the map to learn which biome each species favors.

items.question: Does Ecos La Brea have active codes?
items.answer: Ecos La Brea occasionally releases promotional codes for free rewards, so check the Ecos La Brea codes page for the current list and redemption steps.
